verdict.rationale: Wave only offers fixed, preset automations. Pro-tier overdue reminders fire on a set schedule (3, 7 and 14 days after an invoice's due date), and bank transactions are auto-categorized, but nothing shows users can write their own event-to-action rules. Wave's marketing pages document no webhook or API automation surface, and the developer portal could not be crawled. Missing for 10: a user-defined rules engine (custom triggers, conditions and actions), user-editable categorization rules, webhook or event subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
